SELECT
    o.id                        AS obligation_id,
    o.document_id,
    o.clause_id,
    o.obligation_type,
    o.date_source,
    o.due_date,
    o.notify_days_before,
    (o.due_date - CURRENT_DATE) AS days_until_due,
    CASE
        WHEN (o.due_date - CURRENT_DATE) <= $3::int THEN 'urgent'
        WHEN (o.due_date - CURRENT_DATE) <= $2::int THEN 'soon'
        ELSE 'upcoming'
    END                         AS urgency,
    d.filename,
    c.clause_type
FROM obligations o
JOIN documents d  ON d.id = o.document_id
LEFT JOIN clauses c ON c.id = o.clause_id
WHERE o.status = 'open'
  AND o.notified_at IS NULL
  AND o.due_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE
  AND (o.due_date - CURRENT_DATE) <= LEAST($1::int, o.notify_days_before)
ORDER BY o.due_date ASC, o.id ASC;

INSERT INTO email_outbox
    (purpose, obligation_id, document_id, to_address, subject, body_text, status)
VALUES
    ($1, $2::bigint, $3::bigint, $4, $5, $6, 'queued')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id AS outbox_id, obligation_id;

UPDATE obligations
SET notified_at = NOW(),
    status      = 'notified'
WHERE id = $1::bigint
  AND notified_at IS NULL
RETURNING id AS obligation_id, notified_at, status;
